preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE (r.rolname = 'nexus_svc' AND (r.rolname = current_user OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid, current_user, 'USAGE'))) OR (r.rolname <> current_user AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid, current_user, 'USAGE') AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND r.rolcanlogin)

changeSet.comment: nexus.text_gate_probe_384/768/1024 become SECURITY DEFINER with an explicit, fail-closed tenant predicate and a fixed search_path, so the GIN text indexes can be index conditions; nexus.chunks gains a SELECT-only permissive policy for the migration role (the function owner) so the definer body carries no security qual; EXECUTE moves from PUBLIC to nexus_svc. Skipped whole (MARK_RAN) when nexus_svc is, or has the privileges of, the migrating role, or when any other RLS-subject login role has them: the owner policy would then bind to that role. Ends with a post-condition that RAISEs unless owners and policy roles are exactly as intended. Same chashes returned (live(c), collection filter, where filters, LIMIT unchanged). RDR-192 / nexus-wbfpw.48.
